The '''''Eta''-class shuttle''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:JediShuttle634EngineCompartment-GOM.png|thumb|left|220px|Ahsoka Tano works in the engine compartment of [[Jedi shuttle 634/Legends|Jedi Shuttle 634]]]]
Developed decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Eta''-class shuttle was a combination of utility and performance. Their narrow hull was rectangular and had surprisingly spacious interior hold. In addition to passengers and their belongings, the shuttle could carry a pair of stowable emergency [[Undicur-class jumpspeeder/Legends|''Undicur''-class jumpspeeders]]. The flight deck was small and spherical, and was [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] on nearly all sides and allowed the pilot high-visibility. A tall vertical stabilizer was attached to the hull's dorsal side; two variable-pitch [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] were mounted port and starboard. Its four engines were turned for long-range efficiency.<ref name="GI" />

==History==
===Republic use===
Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, the ''Eta''-class shuttle was used primarily used by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and the [[Republic Ambassadorial Corps]] for transporting VIPs on assignments. Solid and reliable, they were regarded as comfortable if not well-appointed.<ref name="EV" />

When the war started, the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] made heavy use of these shuttles for both public and clandestine operations.<ref name="EV" /> It was used by a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] used it to board [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Separatist destroyer]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], dropping out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the middle of the opposing fleets in order to reach Grievous's ship unnoticed. The vessel survived the battle and was used to transport the rescued [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and the team away from the enemy ship.<ref name="GI" />

[[File:Eta-class_shuttle.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Anakin and Ahsoka traveling to Mandalore.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Anakin Skywalker used an ''Eta''-class shuttle to deliver his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], where she was to teach classes at the [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]].<ref name="Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref>

Later in the war, it was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to hunt down [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="HfZ">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> Thereafter, [[Jedi shuttle 634/Legends|one]] was again used by Kenobi, alongside Skywalker and his padawan, Ahsoka Tano, to [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|investigate]] an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that had been mysteriously activated in the [[Chrelythiumn system/Legends|Chrelythiumn system]]. In so doing, the Jedi stumbled upon a [[Mortis monolith/Legends|mysterious structure]] that absorbed the ship, where they awoke on the planet [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], their ship still perfectly intact but mysteriously nonfunctional. There, the three would discover the presence of [[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]], who believed Skywalker to be the prophesied [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]], and the Jedi became enmeshed in a power struggle between the mystical anchorites, wherein [[Son/Legends|Son]] wanted to use the shuttle to flee Mortis and thereby pursue his goals of galactic reformation. Ultimately, however, Skywalker and the others were able to prevent Son's attempts at leaving, and, having succeeded in that goal, rematerialized aboard their shuttle in the midst of space.<ref name="GoM" /> Another ''Eta''-class shuttle was utilized by Obi-Wan Kenobi again when he ventured to [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] to face [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> 

Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] flew in a ''Eta''-class shuttle while investigating a [[Raid on the Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|raid]] on the [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|Cybloc Transfer Station]] before tracking a stolen [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 Aurore-class freighter]], called [[ALC-9]] to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] where during a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish]], Maul used the Force to pulled it off the cliffside, obstructing the pirates and Kenobi's pursuit, which allowed Maul and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to escape on their stolen cargo ship before it was shot down with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]].<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref> 

[[File:SidiousShuttle-TL.png|thumb|right|220px|Sidious' Eta-class shuttle when he went to Mandalore.]]
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used an [[Darth Sidious' Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]] to travel to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] at some point after Kenobi's [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|confrontation]] with Darth Maul.<ref name="S5Exclusive">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2012/07/14/comic-con-star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5-exclusive-meet-obi-wans-surprising-new-allies|text=Comic-Con: ''Star Wars The Clone Wars'' Season 5 Exclusive - Meet Obi-Wan's Surprising New Allies|archivedate=20120717003158}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]], Skywalker, Rex, and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] flew an ''Eta''-class shuttle to investigate a lost of contact with the shuttle carrying [[Tup/Legends|Tup]].<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref> 

Skywalker and Kenobi flew an ''Eta''-class shuttle when they were tasked by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to investigate Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]'s death on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] before driving it to [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] where they learned how he actually died.<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> 

===Imperial rule===
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, the ''Eta''-class shuttle was slowly phased out. Shutting down production, [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] replaced them with the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class]]. Most were lost, retired through attrition after hard use, accidents, and abandonment during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="EV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Eta''-class shuttle's design was based on concept art of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], created by [[Joe Johnston]] for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="EGGI" />
